title: Polish Pork and Dumplings
description: A hearty Polish-inspired dish featuring tender pork and fluffy dumplings.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
2. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
3. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
4. Roll each piece into a thin circle.
5. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
6. In a separate pan, cook the pork shoulder over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
7. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook the pork for 1-2 hours, until tender and falling apart.
8. Slice the cooked pork into thin strips.
9. Serve the pork with the dumplings and sautéed onion and garlic.
10. Season with black pepper to taste.
